questions.stem_text:
Which of the following best describes the primary way in which a distributed denial-
ofservice (D D o S) attack differs from a denial-ofservice (D o S) attack?

options.B: The number of computers being attacked
options.C: The number of computers launching the attack
options.D: The time period in which the attack occurs

questions.answer_explanation: A distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) attack involves multiple compromised computers coordinating to overwhelm a target system, whereas a denial-of-service (DoS) attack typically originates from a single source, making the number of attacking computers the primary distinguishing factor.

questions.stem_text: Bitmap graphics allow for the accurate representation of all line segments as straight lines without distortion.
questions.answer_explanation: Bitmap graphics represent images as a grid of pixels, which can lead to distortion and jagged edges when depicting straight lines, especially at lower resolutions.

questions.stem_text: The ratio of nonterminal nodes to total nodes in a complete K-ary tree of depth N is approximately (K-1)/K.
questions.answer_explanation: The ratio of nonterminal nodes to total nodes in a complete K-ary tree of depth N is actually (K^N - 1)/(K^N - 1 + 1) rather than (K-1)/K, as nonterminal nodes are defined as those with children, which depends on the total number of nodes at each level of the tree.

questions.stem_text: A 3-way, set-associative cache allows each main memory word to be stored in any of 3 designated cache locations.
